discordPostHtml:
An attempt to improve upon one of vanilla's crustiest sprites (sorry, but David's last resprite wasn't enough for me).

This miniscule mod simply overrides the Onslaught's base sprites. All changes are purely cosmetic.

The sprites are free to use for whatever you like.

Download: https://drive.google.com/uc?export=download&id=1_gXJpCl4VfbGjZ4AvrPH6IQ_R4hBvTBT
